title: Installment Property Delivery Metrics
description: Delivery metrics at the intersection of one installment and one publisher property. The property operational key is (publisher_domain, identifier.type, identifier.value). This row proves where a specific airing, episode, issue, or programming block delivered; independent by_installment and by_property marginals do not.

verifier_constraints.property_domain_consistency: property_ref.publisher_domain MUST equal publisher_domain when property_ref is present

installment_name.description: Current human-readable installment name. Convenience metadata only.

scheduled_at.description: Convenience echo of the installment's scheduled publication or air time.

publisher_domain.description: Publisher or platform authority that namespaces the property identifier, including for an unregistered surface.

identifier.description: Operational identity of the property that delivered the installment.

property_ref.description: Canonical publisher-scoped catalog identity when available. Its publisher_domain MUST equal the row's publisher_domain.

property_name.description: Current human-readable property name. Convenience metadata only.
